Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Three bright moths rise from your palm. You send one around the doorframe while the others settle above your companions' hands.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Up to three visible unoccupied squares within 4 squares.
Type
Magic / Utility

Create up to three lights for the scene. Each illuminates its square and adjacent squares. With a Maneuver, move each light up to 2 squares along an open route, keeping it within 6 squares of you. You can end any of your lights freely; recasting replaces your previous lights.
